principles: Broad audience, creative does the targeting: Paris + 30 km, Advantage+ audience, no interest stacking (ads skill, Meta Andromeda playbook).
Few campaigns, enough budget per ad set to learn: 2 campaigns + a last-48h push, not 4.
Each ad is a distinct concept (saxophone, house at midnight, hour-by-hour journey, Istanbul identity, Turkish-language), not 5 copies of one video.
Identity triggers in the copy: 'Istanbul', 'Bosphore', 'Paris', Turkish text for the diaspora; long primary text gives Meta context.
Retargeting shows a different angle (programme, practical info, urgency), never the same ad again.
Judge after ~48 h and enough impressions; cut only clear losers; never raise budget without approval.
Loi Évin: no drinks in images or text. Special ad category: none.
